_comment: Cases for distribute_discount's largest-remainder pass-1 identity. Ported from discount.rs's own tests (test_simple_distribution, test_remainder_distribution) plus authored skewed-subtotal cases, all with discount <= total (the regime proof/MeteroidVerify/DiscountConservation.lean proves conservative). The discount > total case (test_discount_gt_sub_total) is deliberately excluded here — that's the real code's non-conservative capping regime, not what this file models.
